# DaZ-Pilot stack. Env vars from .env (copy from .env.example).
#
# This file publishes nothing on the host: every service is only reachable from
# inside the compose network, so a deployment needs a reverse proxy that joins
# the network and routes to `backend:4000` and `dashboard:3000`. That makes it
# the file to hand to a server or to Coolify unchanged.
#
# Start deployment stack (npm run docker:up):
#   docker compose up -d --build
#
# Start with host ports for local work (npm run docker:local):
#   docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml up --build
#
# Start with host ports and hot-reload (npm run docker:dev):
#   docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml \
#     -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build
#
# The `backup` service starts with the stack (see infra/backup/BACKUP.md) and
# requires AGE_RECIPIENT in .env. One-off run:
#   docker compose run --rm backup backup.sh
#
# Personal additions (Adminer, …) go in docker-compose.override.yml (gitignored)
# — auto-loaded when starting from the repo root without -f.

# Env shared by `backend` and `worker` (same image, different command).
x-backend-env: &backend-env
  NODE_ENV: production
  ENVIRONMENT: ${ENVIRONMENT:-production}
  LOG_LEVEL: ${LOG_LEVEL:-info}
  LOG_LEVEL_HTTP: ${LOG_LEVEL_HTTP:-info}
  NETWORK_INTERFACE: 0.0.0.0
  PORT: 4000
  WORKER_PORT: 4001
  # Number of reverse proxies in front of the API. Must match the deployment or
  # the auth rate limiters bucket every caller together (0) or trust a spoofable
  # X-Forwarded-For (too high).
  TRUST_PROXY: ${TRUST_PROXY:-0}
  # Requests per client IP per 15 minutes across *all* /auth routes. One login
  # costs four of them. Whenever TRUST_PROXY cannot separate clients, a whole
  # school shares one bucket — raise this before a class logs in at once.
  AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX: ${AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX:-60}
  CORE_BACKEND_DOMAIN: ${CORE_BACKEND_DOMAIN}
  FRONTEND_DOMAIN: ${FRONTEND_DOMAIN}
  SEND_SERVER_ERROR_MESSAGE: ${SEND_SERVER_ERROR_MESSAGE:-false}
  DB_HOST: postgres
  DB_PORT: 5432
  DB_USER: ${DB_USER}
  DB_PASS: ${DB_PASS}
  DB_NAME: ${DB_NAME}
  DB_SSL: ${DB_SSL:-false}
  DB_POOL_SIZE: ${DB_POOL_SIZE:-10}
  DB_DEBUG_SLOW_DB_ACCESS: ${DB_DEBUG_SLOW_DB_ACCESS:-0}
  DB_MAX_DEADLOCKS: ${DB_MAX_DEADLOCKS:-100}
  QDRANT_HOST: qdrant
  QDRANT_PORT: 6333
  ML_SERVICE_URL: http://ml-service:8000
  ML_SERVICE_TIMEOUT_MS: ${ML_SERVICE_TIMEOUT_MS:-120000}
  MEDIA_STORAGE_DIR: /app/media
  MEDIA_PUBLIC_PATH: ${MEDIA_PUBLIC_PATH:-/media}
  MEDIA_URL_SIGNING_KEY: ${MEDIA_URL_SIGNING_KEY}
  FRAME_EXTRACTION_FPS: ${FRAME_EXTRACTION_FPS:-5}
  FRAME_EXTRACTION_CANDIDATES_PER_FRAME: ${FRAME_EXTRACTION_CANDIDATES_PER_FRAME:-3}
  SUPER_ADMIN_API_KEY: ${SUPER_ADMIN_API_KEY}
  SECRETS_ENCRYPTION_KEY: ${SECRETS_ENCRYPTION_KEY}
  # Without SMTP the email OTP is generated, stored and then dropped — the only
  # login that works without an identity provider breaks silently. Default on so
  # a misconfigured mail server fails loudly instead.
  SMTP_ENABLED: ${SMTP_ENABLED:-true}
  SMTP_HOST: ${SMTP_HOST}
  SMTP_PORT: ${SMTP_PORT:-587}
  SMTP_USERNAME: ${SMTP_USERNAME}
  SMTP_PASSWORD: ${SMTP_PASSWORD}
  SMTP_FROM_EMAIL: ${SMTP_FROM_EMAIL}
  SMTP_FROM_NAME: ${SMTP_FROM_NAME:-DaZ-Pilot}
  # Served in /.well-known/assetlinks.json and /apple-app-site-association.
  # Required for the OIDC redirect to reach the mobile app via app links —
  # without them the callback dead-ends in the browser.
  UPLOAD_KEY_FINGERPRINT: ${UPLOAD_KEY_FINGERPRINT:-}
  PLAY_APP_SIGNING_FINGERPRINT: ${PLAY_APP_SIGNING_FINGERPRINT:-}
  APPLE_APP_TEAM_ID: ${APPLE_APP_TEAM_ID:-}

# `backend`, `worker` and `migrate` all use the same image.
# The `image:` tag lets Compose build it once and reuse it across the three services.
x-backend-build: &backend-build
  image: daz-pilot-backend:latest
  build:
    context: ./backend
    dockerfile: Dockerfile

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:17-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${DB_USER}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASS}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${DB_NAME}
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U ${DB_USER} -d ${DB_NAME}"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  qdrant:
    image: qdrant/qdrant:v1.14.0
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - qdrant_storage:/qdrant/storage
      # Shared with `backup` so restore.sh can recover via file:///qdrant/snapshots/...
      - qdrant_snapshots:/qdrant/snapshots
    healthcheck:
      # Qdrant ships without curl/wget — probe via bash /dev/tcp.
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "bash -c '>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/6333' || exit 1"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  ml-service:
    build:
      context: ./ml-service
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    restart: unless-stopped
    expose:
      - "8000"
    environment:
      QDRANT_HOST: qdrant
      QDRANT_PORT: 6333
      # "auto" -> CPU in containers; override to "cuda" for GPU hosts.
      ML_DEVICE: ${ML_DEVICE:-auto}
      # Embed batch size = scan-latency knob. The embedder frees its slot at
      # every batch boundary, so a scan arriving mid-ingest waits at most one
      # batch. Default 8 (not the service default 32) keeps that wait ~10 s on
      # CPU-only hosts; raise it on GPU where throughput benefits from 32.
      EMBED_BATCH_SIZE: ${EMBED_BATCH_SIZE:-8}
      AUG_PRESET: ${AUG_PRESET:-off}
      AUG_COUNT: ${AUG_COUNT:-0}
      MIN_CONFIDENCE_RATIO: ${MIN_CONFIDENCE_RATIO:-1.5}
      # Persist the HuggingFace model cache so SigLIP (4.6 GB) isn't re-downloaded on restart.
      HF_HOME: /cache/huggingface
      TRANSFORMERS_CACHE: /cache/huggingface
    volumes:
      - ml_model_cache:/cache/huggingface
    depends_on:
      qdrant:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      # start_period is generous: first run downloads 4.6 GB of SigLIP weights.
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -fsS http://localhost:8000/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 300s

  # One-shot migration — runs before the backend, then exits.
  # Native dev workflow uses `npm run database:migrate` instead.
  migrate:
    <<: *backend-build
    restart: "no"
    command: ["npm", "run", "start:migrate"]
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
      ENVIRONMENT: ${ENVIRONMENT:-production}
      DB_HOST: postgres
      DB_PORT: 5432
      DB_USER: ${DB_USER}
      DB_PASS: ${DB_PASS}
      DB_NAME: ${DB_NAME}
      DB_SSL: ${DB_SSL:-false}
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy

  backend:
    <<: *backend-build
    restart: unless-stopped
    expose:
      - "4000"
    environment: *backend-env
    volumes:
      - media_data:/app/media
    depends_on:
      migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
      qdrant:
        condition: service_healthy
      ml-service:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      # 127.0.0.1, not localhost: /etc/hosts maps localhost to both 127.0.0.1
      # and ::1, and BusyBox wget tries only the first address it gets. The
      # server binds IPv4 only, so the IPv6 attempt is refused and the service
      # never turns healthy.
      test:
        ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1:4000/api/v1/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s

  # Same image as `backend`, runs the pg-boss job loop instead of the HTTP server.
  worker:
    <<: *backend-build
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["npm", "run", "start:worker"]
    environment: *backend-env
    volumes:
      - media_data:/app/media
    depends_on:
      migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
      qdrant:
        condition: service_healthy
      ml-service:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      # The worker serves nothing but this probe (see worker.ts). start_period is
      # longer than the backend's because crash recovery runs before the health
      # server binds. See the backend healthcheck for why this is not localhost.
      test:
        ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1:4001/api/v1/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s

  # Next.js dashboard. Build context is repo root (needs backend/workspaces/backend-api-types).
  # NEXT_PUBLIC_CORE_BACKEND_DOMAIN is baked into the client bundle at build time.
  dashboard:
    image: daz-pilot-dashboard:latest
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: dashboard/Dockerfile
      args:
        NEXT_PUBLIC_CORE_BACKEND_DOMAIN: ${NEXT_PUBLIC_CORE_BACKEND_DOMAIN:-http://localhost:4000}
    restart: unless-stopped
    expose:
      - "3000"
    # next.config.ts calls validateEnv() on `next start` too, so the same URLs
    # must be present at runtime — not only as build args.
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
      PORT: 3000
      CORE_BACKEND_DOMAIN: http://backend:4000
      NEXT_PUBLIC_CORE_BACKEND_DOMAIN: ${NEXT_PUBLIC_CORE_BACKEND_DOMAIN:-http://localhost:4000}
      SCHOOL_SLUG: ${SCHOOL_SLUG:-}
    depends_on:
      backend:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test:
        [
          "CMD-SHELL",
          "wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1:3000/ >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1",
        ]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 20s

  # Online backups of postgres, qdrant and media_data. Starts with the stack and
  # runs on BACKUP_SCHEDULE; needs AGE_RECIPIENT in .env or it exits immediately.
  # Manual run:  docker compose run --rm backup backup.sh
  # See infra/backup/BACKUP.md. Excluded from the hot-reload dev override.
  backup:
    image: daz-pilot-backup:latest
    build:
      context: ./infra/backup
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    restart: unless-stopped
    init: true
    environment:
      DB_HOST: postgres
      DB_PORT: 5432
      DB_USER: ${DB_USER}
      DB_PASS: ${DB_PASS}
      DB_NAME: ${DB_NAME}
      DB_SSL: ${DB_SSL:-false}
      QDRANT_HOST: qdrant
      QDRANT_PORT: 6333
      BACKUP_SCHEDULE: ${BACKUP_SCHEDULE:-0 3 * * *}
      BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS: ${BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS:-30}
      BACKUP_ALLOW_PLAINTEXT: ${BACKUP_ALLOW_PLAINTEXT:-false}
      BACKUP_QDRANT_TIMEOUT_SEC: ${BACKUP_QDRANT_TIMEOUT_SEC:-600}
      AGE_RECIPIENT: ${AGE_RECIPIENT:-}
      AGE_IDENTITY_FILE: ${AGE_IDENTITY_FILE:-}
      TZ: ${TZ:-UTC}
    volumes:
      - backup_data:/backups
      - media_data:/media
      - qdrant_snapshots:/qdrant-snapshots
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      qdrant:
        condition: service_healthy

volumes:
  postgres_data:
  qdrant_storage:
  qdrant_snapshots:
  ml_model_cache:
  media_data:
  backup_data:

# DaZ-Pilot – Docker Compose env vars.
# Copy to .env and fill in the secrets:  cp .env.example .env

# ── Environment ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ENVIRONMENT=development
LOG_LEVEL=info
LOG_LEVEL_HTTP=info
SEND_SERVER_ERROR_MESSAGE=false

# ── Published host ports ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Only read by docker-compose.local.yml. The base stack publishes nothing.
# Postgres defaults to 5433 so it does not collide with a host installation.
POSTGRES_PORT=5433
ML_SERVICE_PORT=8000
BACKEND_PORT=4000
DASHBOARD_PORT=3000

# ── Server / CORS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Public URL at which the core-backend serves the API (used for absolute URLs).
CORE_BACKEND_DOMAIN=http://localhost:4000
# Origin allowed by CORS (mobile app / dashboard).
FRONTEND_DOMAIN=http://localhost:3000
# Baked into the dashboard client bundle at build time (for Next.js Image remotePatterns).
NEXT_PUBLIC_CORE_BACKEND_DOMAIN=http://localhost:4000
# Optional. On-premises single-school installs: dashboard skips the school-slug
# screen and opens this school's login. Leave empty for multi-school hosting.
SCHOOL_SLUG=

# Number of reverse proxies in front of the API. 0 when reachable directly,
# 1 behind a single nginx/Caddy/Traefik. Too low and every client shares one
# rate-limit bucket; too high and clients can spoof X-Forwarded-For.
TRUST_PROXY=0

# Requests per client IP per 15 minutes across all /auth routes; one login costs
# four. Whenever TRUST_PROXY cannot tell clients apart (a school behind one NAT
# gateway), the whole site shares this budget — raise it for classroom use.
AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=60

# ── Database ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DB_USER=daz
DB_PASS=daz-dev-password
DB_NAME=daz
DB_SSL=false
DB_POOL_SIZE=10
DB_DEBUG_SLOW_DB_ACCESS=0
DB_MAX_DEADLOCKS=100

# ── ML-Service ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# "auto" resolves to CPU in containers. Override to "cuda" for GPU hosts.
ML_DEVICE=auto
ML_SERVICE_TIMEOUT_MS=120000

# ── Media storage & ingest ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
MEDIA_PUBLIC_PATH=/media
# Signs the time-limited media URLs. Must be 32 bytes, base64 (the placeholder
# below happens to decode to exactly that). Generate:  openssl rand -base64 32
MEDIA_URL_SIGNING_KEY=replace-with-32-random-bytes-base64-encoded
FRAME_EXTRACTION_FPS=3
FRAME_EXTRACTION_CANDIDATES_PER_FRAME=3

# ── Secrets ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Both values below are throwaway defaults so that `cp .env.example .env` plus
# `docker compose up` works out of the box. Replace them in any deployment.

# Min. 64 characters. Generate:  openssl rand -hex 48
SUPER_ADMIN_API_KEY=dev-only-super-admin-api-key-replace-in-production-0000000000000000

# Encrypts the per-school OIDC client secrets at rest — anyone holding this key
# can decrypt them. Must be 32 bytes, base64. Generate:  openssl rand -base64 32
SECRETS_ENCRYPTION_KEY=ZGV2LW9ubHkta2V5LW5vdC1mb3ItcHJvZHVjdGlvbiE=

# ── SMTP ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Email OTP is the only login that works without an identity provider, so a
# reachable mail server is mandatory in every deployment. There are no working
# defaults here — fill in a real relay.
#
# Port 465 means implicit TLS, anything else negotiates STARTTLS.
#
# Locally you can skip the mail server: SMTP_ENABLED=false together with
# ENVIRONMENT=development writes the login code into the backend log instead of
# sending it. In any other environment the code is silently discarded.
SMTP_ENABLED=true
SMTP_HOST=smtp.example.org
SMTP_PORT=587
SMTP_USERNAME=
SMTP_PASSWORD=
SMTP_FROM_EMAIL=noreply@example.org
SMTP_FROM_NAME=DaZ-Pilot

# ── Mobile app links ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Served in /.well-known/assetlinks.json and /apple-app-site-association so the
# OIDC callback can hand off from the browser to the installed app. Leave empty
# until the store credentials exist; the callback then stays in the browser.
UPLOAD_KEY_FINGERPRINT=
PLAY_APP_SIGNING_FINGERPRINT=
APPLE_APP_TEAM_ID=

# ── Backups ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# The `backup` service starts with the stack and backs up Postgres, Qdrant and
# media_data online (no downtime). See infra/backup/BACKUP.md.
BACKUP_SCHEDULE=0 3 * * *
BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS=30
# age public key from `age-keygen`. Without it the service exits on start —
# set BACKUP_ALLOW_PLAINTEXT=true only for local, throwaway data.
AGE_RECIPIENT=
BACKUP_ALLOW_PLAINTEXT=false
# Identity file is only needed for restore (mount it; do not commit it):
# AGE_IDENTITY_FILE=/run/age/identity
# Optional; default 600. Raise for large Qdrant snapshots.
# BACKUP_QDRANT_TIMEOUT_SEC=600
# TZ=UTC

FROM python:3.11-slim

WORKDIR /app

RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential curl && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir torch torchvision --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu && \
    pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

# python:3.11-slim ships no unprivileged account, so create one. The only
# runtime write target is the HuggingFace cache (HF_HOME, a named volume in
# compose); code in /app and site-packages stay root-owned and read-only.
